QuestInfo.name: [Chu Chu] A Taste of Skywhale Mountain 1
QuestInfo.0: Pidol is the youngest of the Pi siblings. He's not all there, but he seems to know everything about high-flying ingredients. Get Pidol's help to complete the 'egg patty.'
QuestInfo.1: Pidol is the youngest of the Pi siblings. He's not all there, but he seems to know everything about high-flying ingredients. Get Pidol's help to complete the 'egg patty.'\r\n\r\nPidol tells you to get Slimy Feathers from Crilia and Sticky Feathers from Patriarch Crilia.
QuestInfo.2: He's not all there, but he seems to know everything about high-flying ingredients.  \r\nWith Pidol's help, you create an egg patty that miraculously contains no eggs. All it needs now is a little spice.
